newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN FIYTA H1 NET JUMPS 85 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN FIYTA H1 NET JUMPS 85 PCT.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated otherwise, against first-half 1996 figures):
Earnings per share 0.351 yuan vs 0.189 yuan
Net assets per share 2.869 yuan vs 2.352 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd.
NOTE: The results, calculated under Chinese accounting standards, were published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Tuesday.
Based on international standards, the watch maker posted net profits of 45.79 million yuan in the first six months of 1997. It gave no comparative figure.
Trading in Fiyta A and B shares was suspended on Tuesday morning pending the announcement, and would resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
